description: Connect a domain the user owns (www.example.com or example.com) to one HTML page or site. Works when the owner token is in a free BrewPage profile (sign-in at https://account.brewpage.app); free, 5 domains per profile. Returns the DNS records for the domain owner to create at their DNS provider: TXT for ownership plus CNAME, or A/ALIAS for a root domain. A DNS check after that moves the status pending_dns -> verifying -> active; HTTPS is issued automatically. HTML pages of format html and sites, without a password. A hostname already in the profile moves to this publication. The BrewPage link keeps working.

hostname.description: Domain or subdomain the user owns, e.g. www.example.com or example.com

ownerToken.description: Owner token in a BrewPage profile: the publication's own token added to the profile, or a profile token. Default: env BREWPAGE_OWNER_TOKEN (local server only).

name: set_domain
title: Connect custom domain
